system.description:
You infuse chakra into chakra seals as you attempt to mark a creature you can see in range with the seal of the desires. You can either target an allied creature or a hostile creature. If you target an allied creature, you can force the creature to experience a hyper accelerated sleep pattern. The target creature gains some of the benefit of a short rest only allowing them to spend hit die to recover hit points.

If targeting a hostile creature, the target must make a Charisma Saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creature is marked with the seal of desires as they begin to see flashes and visions of the things they want most in life causing them to freeze in place, focusing on the things before them. For the duration, at the beginning a marked creatures turn remake the saving throw, being Dazed on a failed save ending this jutsu’s effect on them.

Critical Failure: Same as failure but the seal remains until the affected creature passes their save or the duration expires.
